title: Filtered Hom continuity for locally finitely presented condensed field modules
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite intermediate field of the algebraic closure of Q_ℓ, X a scheme with noetherian underlying space, and P a locally finitely presented internal module over the condensed coefficient field E on X. For any (u+1)-small filtered diagram N of cochain complexes with a common termwise lower bound and any integer n, the canonical map colim Hom(P[0],QN_i[n]) → Hom(P[0],Q(colim N)[n]) is an isomorphism.

theorem condensed_lfp_hom_continuity
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.val) X))
    (hP : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.val) X) P)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.val) X)) ℤ)
    (hN : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (i : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((N.obj i).X r))
    (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (colimit.desc _
      ((condensedShiftedHom (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.val) X
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) n).mapCocone (colimit.cocone N)))
